scenario.goal: Reach workspace settings, change the name, and verify the desktop reflects it
scenario.name: Rename a workspace

coverage: Real retained shell/widget input path; isolated fixture state
Layout and screenshots in logical pixels; physical wheel input uses declared scale
Visibility checks declared clipping and hidden state, not sibling-overlay occlusion
Contrast covers explicit rendered pixel pairs only; no whole-screen certification
Hardware delivery, native gesture arbitration, perceived ease and animation smoothness require live acceptance
